title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Daniel W. Sack is a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, where he teaches First-Year Legal Research and Writing. Outside of teaching, Mr. Sack is a practitioner in the Boston office of Latham and Watkins LLP, where he focuses on complex commercial litigation and policyholder-side insurance litigation.
